exposure: Abnormal uterine artery Doppler indices (resistance index (RI), pulsatility index (PI))
outcome: Fetal biometrics (biparietal diameter (BPD), head circumference (HC), abdominal circumference (AC), femur length (FL), and estimated fetal weight (EFW))
cohort: 80 pregnant women between 26 and 38 weeks gestation diagnosed with preeclampsia
finding: Abnormal uterine artery Doppler, especially RI, was significantly associated with fetal growth restriction and several maternal and infant complications.
